title: Go workspace independence
description: Enforce that Go-based scenario CLIs build with GOWORK=off and that scenario modules using shared Vrooli Go packages declare required non-transitive local replace directives.

requirements.title: Go scenario modules are workspace-independent
requirements.description: The rule fails if any Go-based scenario CLI fails `GOWORK=off go build ./...` or if a scenario Go module using shared Vrooli packages is missing required non-transitive replace directives.
